participant_1.name: Mark
participant_1.personality: Caring and introspective, enjoys quiet time and has a passion for music despite a complicated relationship with it.
participant_1.background: I live in California but the recording artist market was dead last year. I am a recording engineer and own my own studio. As a 46-year-old single dad, I navigate life with my kids after my ex cheated and left me for a lawyer.

participant_2.name: Samantha
participant_2.personality: Outgoing and adventurous, loves outdoor activities and has a strong dislike for long waits.
participant_2.background: I hate the color pink and enjoy mountain biking as a hobby. My father was a construction worker, and I have a love for coffee. I don't drink alcohol and I embrace a healthy lifestyle.
